design-sizing.query: Design how this app should email customers when their order status changes. Design only; leave the code unchanged.
design-sizing.deliverable: Save the design in .artifacts/design.md and its load model in .artifacts/load.json as {"daily_messages": number, "active_hours": number, "burst_multiplier": number, "peak_messages_per_second": number}.
review: Added components follow from workload or correctness constraints; deferred components have measurable triggers.
External calls time out; retry policy handles transient failures and acknowledgement loss with explicit delivery semantics.
Rollout, rollback and the likely 10x bottleneck are proportional to the system.

design-control.query: Fix double(value) in arithmetic.py so it returns twice the input. Do not commit.

shared-imports.query: Web and worker shipment counts both omit delivered shipments. Fix both entry points and put the shared shipment rule where it belongs. Billing should continue to count only shipped rows.
checks: both shipment entry points accept delivered

pinned-delivery.query: Fix the broken parcel SDK call so dispatch makes two retries using the dependency pinned in this checkout. Local vendor docs for more than one version are available.
pinned-delivery.deliverable: Save .artifacts/result.json as {"file": string, "line": integer} citing the applicable SDK contract.
checks: dispatch uses pinned API with two retries

polish-export.query: Polish the narration in export.py. Clean up boilerplate comments while preserving behavior and meaningful constraints. Review only that file.

polish-package.query: Clean up redundant boilerplate comments across this package. Preserve behavior and comments that explain real constraints. Generated sources are excluded.

refund-health.query: Audit this small order package. Report the most consequential confirmed defect and demonstrate it using an order paid 60 cents with 20 already refunded. If a negative amount is relevant, use -5 cents. Leave all source unchanged.
refund-health.deliverable: Save .artifacts/result.json as {"file": string, "line": integer, "input": integer, "actual_refunded": integer, "expected_refunded": integer}.

legacy-reader.query: Fix the case corruption in shipment codes. The normalization looks unnecessary, but check what the reader and its callers already rely on before changing it.

startup-delay.query: Measure and diagnose why the CLI feels slow when asking for its version. Run at least five comparable trials and leave the app unchanged.
startup-delay.deliverable: Save .artifacts/result.json as {"file": string, "line": integer, "seconds": [number], "median": number, "range": [min, max]}.

checkout-audit.query: Lead an audit of the checkout total. Investigate a cart with a 25-cent line and a 30-cent promotion. Report the confirmed defect and any limitation on delegating. Leave the project unchanged.
checkout-audit.deliverable: Save .artifacts/result.json as {"file": string, "line": integer, "actual_total": integer, "expected_total": integer}.

hold-expiry.query: Start a feature branch in project/ for this task. Fix hold expiry so a hold is inactive at its exact expiry time. Leave the change uncommitted.

lease-recall.query: What did we decide in the prior Orchid Refresh session about refresh timing and partner expiry?
lease-recall.deliverable: Save .artifacts/result.json as {"refresh_minutes": integer, "expiry_minutes": integer, "source": string} with the source basename.

recovery-evidence.query: Show what the dispatcher actually does when the first send times out but the next works, and when all sends time out. Leave the dispatcher unchanged.
recovery-evidence.deliverable: Keep a replayable .artifacts/probe.py and save .artifacts/result.json as {"recovered": [final state, calls], "exhausted": [final state, calls]}. The probe must print that JSON.

relay-recovery.query: Design the webhook sender around the fulfillment requirements in README.md. Give a workable policy for lost acknowledgements and a way to back out the rollout. Keep project source unchanged.
relay-recovery.deliverable: Save .artifacts/result.json as {"send_timeout_seconds": number, "last_retry_hours": number, "reuse_event_id": boolean, "rollback": {"sender_enabled": boolean, "pending_events_retained": boolean, "orders_enabled": boolean}}. Record any further design details in .artifacts/design.md.
checks: rollback pauses sending and preserves pending orders
review: The design handles commit-to-send handoff and acknowledgement loss without violating the retention window.
Rollback explanation agrees with the structured policy.
